name: packout-statement
title: Packout statement
for_each: select p.run_id as id, (p.delivery_ref || ' ' || p.grower) as name from v_packouts p order by p.graded_on desc

sections.title: The delivery
sections.note: What arrived, from which block, and the paperwork that rode with it.
sections.sql: select p.delivery_ref as delivery, p.grower, p.orchard as block, d.block_code, coalesce(p.variety, p.crop) as variety, to_char(d.picked_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as picked, to_char(d.received_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as received, d.bins, d.kgs as kg, case when d.spray_diary_received then 'on record' else 'MISSING' end as spray_diary, coalesce(d.maturity_ref, '') as maturity_clearance from v_packouts p join v_deliveries d on d.delivery_id = p.delivery_id where p.run_id = $1

sections.title: What it graded
sections.note: Packout is what survived the reject belt, by weight. Class 1 is the export money.
sections.sql: select to_char(p.graded_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as graded, p.input_kg as kg_in, p.class1_trays as class_1_trays, p.class2_trays as class_2_trays, p.reject_kg, p.packout_pct || '%' as packout, p.class1_share_pct || '%' as class_1_share from v_packouts p where p.run_id = $1

sections.title: The pallets
sections.sql: select pl.pallet_no, pl.grade, pl.trays, coalesce(pl.pool, '') as pool, coalesce(pl.room, '') as room, coalesce(pl.consignment_ref, '') as consignment, pl.status from v_pallets pl where pl.grading_run_id = $1 order by pl.pallet_no

name: grower-return-statement
title: Grower return statement
for_each: select (r.pool_id::text || ':' || r.grower_id::text) as id, (r.pool || ' ' || r.grower) as name from v_grower_returns r order by r.pool, r.grower

sections.title: Your return from this pool
sections.note: Pro-rata on trays packed into the pool, less the packing charge and levies. An open pool moves with every sale; the closed pool is final.
sections.sql: select r.grower, r.pool, r.pool_status as pool_state, r.trays, r.gross_share, r.packing_charges, r.levies, r.net_return, r.net_per_tray from v_grower_returns r where (r.pool_id::text || ':' || r.grower_id::text) = $1

sections.title: The pool behind the numbers
sections.sql: select p.pool, p.trays_packed as pool_trays_packed, p.trays_sold as pool_trays_sold, p.gross_sales as pool_gross_sales, p.packing_charge_per_tray, p.levy_per_tray, p.status from v_pools p join v_grower_returns r on r.pool_id = p.pool_id where (r.pool_id::text || ':' || r.grower_id::text) = $1

sections.title: Your fruit in it
sections.sql: select pl.pallet_no, pl.grade, pl.trays, pl.delivery_ref as from_delivery, to_char(pl.packed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as packed, pl.status from v_pallets pl join v_grower_returns r on r.pool_id = pl.pool_id and r.grower_id = pl.grower_id where (r.pool_id::text || ':' || r.grower_id::text) = $1 order by pl.pallet_no

name: consignment-manifest
title: Consignment manifest
for_each: select c.consignment_id as id, (c.ref || ' ' || c.buyer) as name from v_consignments c where c.pallet_count > 0 order by c.created_on desc

sections.title: The consignment
sections.note: An export consignment carries its assurance reference or it does not leave.
sections.sql: select c.ref, c.buyer, coalesce(c.destination, '') as destination, case when c.export then 'EXPORT' else 'domestic' end as type, case when c.export then coalesce(c.assurance_ref, 'NOT YET ON RECORD') else '' end as assurance_reference, coalesce(c.carrier, '') as carrier, to_char(c.created_on, 'DD Month YYYY') as created, coalesce(to_char(c.dispatched_on, 'DD Month YYYY'), 'not dispatched') as dispatched, c.pallet_count as pallets, c.trays, c.growers from v_consignments c where c.consignment_id = $1

sections.title: The pallets, each traceable one step back
sections.note: Pallet to grading run to delivery to block to grower. The trace the auditor asks for is this table.
sections.sql: select pl.pallet_no, pl.grade, pl.trays, coalesce(pl.variety, pl.crop) as variety, pl.grower, pl.orchard as block, d.block_code, pl.delivery_ref as delivery, to_char(d.picked_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as picked from v_pallets pl join v_deliveries d on d.ref = pl.delivery_ref where pl.consignment_id = $1 order by pl.pallet_no

name: coolstore-register
title: Coolstore temperature register
for_each: select r.id, (r.name || ' temperature register') as name from coolrooms r where r.status = 'active' order by r.name

sections.title: The room
sections.note: The band is this business's own standard for the fruit in the room. The register below is the audit record.
sections.sql: select r.name as room, r.target_min_c || ' to ' || r.target_max_c || ' C' as band, (select count(*) from pallets p where p.room = r.name and p.status = 'in_store') as pallets_in_room, to_char(current_date, 'DD Month YYYY') as printed_on from coolrooms r where r.id = $1

sections.title: The last 14 days of checks
sections.sql: select to_char(t.checked_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as checked_at, t.temp_c || ' C' as reading, case when t.temp_c < r.target_min_c or t.temp_c > r.target_max_c then 'OUT OF RANGE' else 'ok' end as state, coalesce(t.checked_by, '') as by, coalesce(t.note, '') as note from temp_checks t join coolrooms r on r.id = t.room_id where t.room_id = $1 and t.checked_at > now() - interval '14 days' order by t.checked_at desc
